film: KOMA ONE: Thirty Frames a Second
line: A street photographer chases a running light to the moment the pigeons rise; her pocket camera splits that second into thirty panels.
line_cn: 街拍摄影师追着一束跑动的光，等到鸽群腾起的那一秒；她的口袋相机把这一秒拆成三十格。

camera.move: Pan along the reading direction across a page wider than the frame
camera.serves: a run; a queue; a process

camera.move: Push into a point inside a panel (an eye, a keyhole), then cut on an impact frame
camera.serves: a decision; a flashback; a zoom into detail

camera.move: Glide through the gutters from panel to panel, one beat each
camera.serves: a day in photos; steps of a recipe; a team roster

camera.move: Pull back from one panel to the whole page
camera.expresses: the moment becomes part of a story
camera.serves: an ending; a reveal of scale

camera.move: Static frame while the panels change around it
camera.expresses: the grid itself is the action

camera.move: Slow push on a single big panel with emotional tone
camera.serves: a smile; a memory; a result

camera.move: A panel splitting along a slanted gutter
camera.expresses: a page giving way to the next
camera.serves: a chapter break; a change of place

labels: Sound effects (katakana, Dela Gothic One): per letter — 1.6–1.9× → 1× slam with overshoot, 0.03–0.09 s stagger, ±10° random rotation, small offsets, three layers (wide ink stroke ×0.34, paper stroke ×0.27, ink fill), boiling ±1.5 px at 12 fps. Small kana (ッ ャ) at 0.62× and dropped. Dela's 「カ」 reads as 「太」 at small sizes: use another word (ドンッ rather than カンッ for a hit).

Narration boxes (Noto Serif SC 900, vertical, right column first, a space starts a new column): paper box, 5 px ink border, offset solid ink shadow, characters ink in one after another. Inner voice, scene-setting, verse lyrics.
Hand-lettered shouts (Noto Sans SC 900, 110–190 px): the same slam engine as the sound effects, horizontal or vertical. Choruses, slogans, anything shouted.
Speech balloons (Noto Serif SC 900, vertical): ellipse with a tail toward the speaker's mouth; full-width comma becomes the vertical form.
motion: Panel ink-in: 0.1 s wipe in the reading direction, content slammed 40–110 px from that direction and settled in 0.22 s.
Boiling: focus lines, speed lines and lettering redraw 8–12 times a second with a new seed; images stay still. Stopping the boil is itself an event (time freezes).
Shake: an exponentially decaying jitter (τ 0.07 s, 6–40 px) on every hit.

Performance comes from pose frames, not from tweening a drawing: a new pose = a new panel. Inside a panel: slide-in, bob (running), head flicks on half-beats, a sweat drop sliding, a tone wiping away.

native_moves.name: Panel = cut, one per beat
native_moves.does: (panel()): fits a list, a montage, a countdown, a beat drop.

native_moves.name: Panel split = burst
native_moves.does: (one panel splits on consecutive beats, for example 1→2→4→8→16, each cell one frame of a motion, cells numbered in reading order, a flash per new cell): fits a fast motion taken apart, a crowd of options, growth.

native_moves.name: Panels merge into a double-page spread
native_moves.does: (gutter lines shrink to zero, then one big panel): fits the moment everything comes together.

native_moves.name: Break the frame
native_moves.does: (出格: a haloed figure or object drawn above the border): fits a hero entrance, a product reveal, an escape.

native_moves.name: Same composition, consecutive panels
native_moves.does: (the same framing three times, something changes each time): fits time passing, a crowd thinning, waiting.

native_moves.name: Anticipation triptych
native_moves.does: (ready → action → close-up, each a new panel and a closer framing): fits the second before a decision.

native_moves.name: The empty panel
native_moves.does: (dashed border, then filled on the beat): fits "next", a blank page, a promise.

native_moves.name: The quiet panel (間)
native_moves.does: (a hard cut to one wide panel on a bare page, the subject at rest, no lettering, no effect lines, at most one glint; held through a real silence): fits the breath after the biggest hit, the moment after a decision.

native_moves.name: Time stop
native_moves.does: (tone wipes away from a point, speed lines retract, boiling stops, one mark locks in place): fits focus, a realisation, slow motion.

native_moves.name: Gutter travel
native_moves.does: (camera through a page of panels): fits a gallery, a contact sheet, a timeline.

score.note: anime-opening rock: power chords, melodic bass, tight drums, 150–170 BPM
